name: Jan de Vries
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport PR began somewhat unconventionally. After a brief stint as a journalist covering local club racing, he realized his talent lay not in reporting the news, but in shaping it. He quickly transitioned to managing the media relations for a small Formula Ford team, honing his skills in navigating the often-turbulent world of racing politics.

At Hitech GP, Jan sees his role as more than just damage control and press releases. He believes in building genuine connections between the team, its drivers, and the fans. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to craft compelling narratives that resonate with both hardcore enthusiasts and casual observers. His distinctive approach involves a deep understanding of motorsport history, allowing him to contextualize current events and create a sense of continuity.

What sets Jan apart is his unwavering commitment to ethical PR. He refuses to engage in spin or misinformation, instead focusing on transparency and honesty, even when dealing with difficult situations. This integrity has earned him the respect of journalists and competitors alike, making him a valuable asset to Hitech GP.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jan is a man of average height with a slightly weathered face that speaks to years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-written PR strategies.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
